english.title: Flying display director permit military aircraft to participate in flying display in non-compliance with conditions
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the flying display director at **(..SPECIFY EVENT..), permitted military aircraft to participate in that display having not complied with a condition concerning military aircraft subject to which the permission for the flying display had been granted, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 86(17) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
